opennyai_summary.PREAMBLE:
Damisetty Chandrasekhar Chandra vs The State Of Andhra
Pradesh on 23 January, 2020
Author: J. Uma Devi
Bench: J. Uma Devi
 The Hon'Ble Ms. Justice J. Uma Devi
 Criminal Petition No.286 Of 2020
Order:
This criminal petition is filed by the petitioner/A.1, seeking to quash the proceedings in FIR No.165 of 2019 dated 12.12.2019 on the file of Gudur I Town Police Station, S.P.S.R. Nellore District registered for the offences under Sections 272, 273, 328 and 188 IPC and Section 59(I) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short, "the Act").
opennyai_summary.decision:
When the matter is taken up for hearing, it is brought to the notice of this Court that in a Criminal Petition No.6205 of 2019 filed by the petitioner therein, this Court passed an order dated 22.10.2019, quashing the proceedings in Crime No.248 of 2019, on the file of the Buchireddypalem Police Station, S.P.S.R. Nellore District registered for the offences under Section 272, 273, 328 IPC and Section 59(i) of the Act.
Following the order passed in the aforementioned criminal petition and for the reasons recorded therein, this criminal petition is allowed quashing the proceedings in FIR No.165 of 2019 dated 12.12.2019 on the file of Gudur I Town Police Station, S.P.S.R. Nellore District registered for the offences under Sections 272, 273, 328 and 188 IPC and Section 59(I) of the Act as against the petitioner/A.1.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any pending, shall also stand closed in consequence.
